deliverables: Periodic independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics
Development of Eternl Core, Eternl Hub, hardware wallet support, wallet data export, and governance tooling
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, improvements, infrastructure, support, administration, and audit/oversight activities.

claims.claim: Eternl requests ₳2,350,000, valued at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover approximately $420,000 of annual operating costs for 12 months.
The budget is allocated as ₳1,292,500 frontend, ₳587,500 backend, ₳117,500 support, ₳305,500 admin, and ₳47,000 audits.
The proposal funds 6.0 FTE distributed across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.
Eternl has about 100,000 browser extension installs and about 30,000 Android and iOS installs, and about 5,500 Pro users would fully cover the annual $420,000 cost.
After withdrawal, the proposer says it will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, place it in a public company wallet, and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.

Independent audits by an unaffiliated party are planned for February 2027 and August 2027 to review custody, conversion, spending, balances, Pro plan income relevant to repayment, and refunds or repayments.

Every December and June, the proposer will use surplus treasury stablecoins plus paid plan income above $420,000 to repay the treasury until $420,000 in Ada has been repaid, then donate 50% of Pro income above $420,000 until an additional $210,000 worth of Ada has been donated.
Eternl states that 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
The main Eternl UI will not be open-source, though some libraries used in Eternl will be published through the Eternl npm organization.

If treasury funds are not received and paid licenses are insufficient beyond August, the proposer says it may let developers go, scale down to essential maintenance, focus outside Cardano, or remove the free option.

summary: The document asks for ₳2,350,000 to fund Eternl for August 2026 through July 2027, presents a category budget and sustainability plan through paid Pro subscriptions, promises public wallet handling and repayment/donation mechanics, and describes audits, operations, roadmap items, prior funding, and ecosystem impact claims.
